card.name: Mago do Tempo
card.summary: Uma vez por turno: declare cara ou coroa. Se acertar, destrua os monstros do oponente. Se errar, destrua os seus e receba metade da soma do ATK em campo dos seus monstros destruídos com a face para cima como dano.

textEvidence.text: Once per turn per copy in your Main Phase, activate without cost or target. Call a coin at resolution. If correct, destroy every opposing monster. Otherwise, destroy as many of your monsters as possible and take effect damage equal to half the sum of the current on-field ATK of your face-up monsters actually destroyed. Count the source if destroyed and exclude face-down monsters from damage. Damage can end the duel.

card.name: Fiend Comedian
card.summary: Declare cara ou coroa. Se acertar, bana todo o Cemitério adversário. Se errar, envie do topo do seu Deck ao Cemitério tantas cartas quantas estiverem no Cemitério adversário.

textEvidence.text: Normal Trap with no cost or target. The opposing graveyard must be nonempty and your Deck must hold at least as many cards at activation. Call a coin during resolution. A correct call banishes every card then in the opposing graveyard. An incorrect call sends that number of cards from your Deck to your graveyard, or all remaining cards if now shorter. Milling is not drawing and does not cause deck-out. Resume lower links after the choice.
